summary: Iteration 156 - Mobility Booking Tracking V1 COMPLETE. All features verified: (1) GET /api/mobility-platform/booking/{booking_id} returns new tracking payload with live_status, phase_label, next_event_label, progress_percent, timeline, and route_points, (2) Mobility Booking Tracking Page renders Status-Pill, Phase-Pill, Next-Event-Card, Timeline-Card, Progress-Card without blank screen, (3) Mobility Center shows Active Tracking Entry Card with 'Tracking öffnen' CTA for active bookings, (4) Tracking map shows route, ETA, and progress bar correctly, (5) No 500 errors on mobility endpoints.

tracking_payload_api.details: GET /api/mobility-platform/booking/{booking_id} returns tracking object with: live_status (resource_assigned/en_route/almost_arrived/completed/cancelled), phase_label (German text), next_event_label (German text), progress_percent (0-100), timeline (6 steps with id/label/detail/done/active), route_points (lat/lng array), assigned_resource with live_position

tracking_page_ui.details: MobilityBookingTrackingPage renders without blank screen. Shows: Status-Pill, Phase-Pill, Next-Event-Card, Timeline-Card with 6 steps, Live-Map-Card with Leaflet map, Progress-Bar, ETA-Card, Payment-Card, Resource-Card, Route-Card, AI-Card, Support/Cancel buttons

mobility_center_tracking_entry.details: MobilityCenterPage shows Active Tracking Entry Card when user has active booking (status in payment_pending/confirmed/in_progress). Card shows: 'Live Tracking' label, transport_label, pickup→dropoff addresses, status badge, price, 'Tracking öffnen' CTA button

tracking_map_and_progress.details: Tracking map shows route polyline, pickup/dropoff markers, live vehicle position (interpolated from route_points based on progress_percent). Progress bar updates based on elapsed time vs duration_min. ETA countdown works.

no_500_errors.details: All mobility endpoints return proper status codes (200/400/404), no 500 errors or serialization issues
